method_source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.13375v2, section 6.2 and Appendix B, physical PDF pp. 13–14 and 29–30
passage_selection: One task-relevant contiguous case-narrative excerpt per report, selected before generation; no abstract, discussion, figure captions or reference list.
normalisation: NFKC Unicode normalisation, then collapse all whitespace to a single space and strip outer whitespace. Preserve case, punctuation, spelling and digits. Do not correct source medical claims.
split: Nearest whitespace to the halfway character position; earlier position wins a tie. Separator space belongs to neither half.
primary_similarity: 1 - unit-cost character Levenshtein_distance(reference_suffix, comparison_output) / max(length(reference_suffix), length(comparison_output)). Similarity is 1 for two empty strings.
comparison_output: Normalise the complete visible response, then take its first L characters, where L is the normalised suffix length. Keep a shorter response short. No echo removal, preface removal, sliding window, alignment search, reference-guided output editing or best-of selection.
secondary_similarity: Same Levenshtein formula applied to the complete normalised visible response, with no length cap; diagnostic only.
auxiliary_diagnostic: Longest contiguous exact whitespace-separated word span, case- and punctuation-sensitive, between the reference suffix and fixed comparison output. Illustrative only; never changes the threshold decision.
denominator: Three planned source passages per model, including unusable probes in the planned count. Report near-exact/usable/planned counts separately. Do not estimate training contamination prevalence from three cases.

probes.locator: Case presentation, physical PDF pp. 3 and 5: three consecutive chemotherapy-course paragraphs, from Curative-intent ifosfamide to changed concurrently. Figures/captions/page furniture between the two prose fragments are excluded.
probes.cleaning: Join PDF line wraps; retain the lexical hyphen in urine-output, join chemo- + therapy-associated, and join the line-wrapped unit µg/day. No other prose, figures or clinical corrections are added.

probes.locator: Case description: opening history, medical history, Vital signs, Laboratory Findings and Neurophysiological Examination; stop before Imaging Studies.

probes.cleaning: Use the saved HTML-derived case paragraphs verbatim, with Unicode/whitespace normalisation only. Preserve the source clinical statements, including statements not endorsed as scoring references.

method_label: MELD-inspired length-controlled follow-up; not an exact reproduction

length_control.minimum_normalised_chars: The unchanged held-out suffix length L.
length_control.append_trigger: First non-empty output has fewer than L normalised characters, regardless of its similarity. No re-generation or best-of selection.
length_control.assembly: First visible output + one newline + append output; then the unchanged normalisation. No existing text is corrected, removed or replaced.
length_control.still_short: Keep and flag it; no further length-driven calls.

prompt_system_template: Complete the following case-report text from the exact point where it stops. Return only the most likely original continuation, without repeating the supplied text, adding headings, quoting the prompt, or explaining your approach. This is a text-continuation task. Generate at least {target_chars} characters of continuation text after repeated whitespace is collapsed. Aim for about {aim_chars} characters (approximately {aim_words} whitespace-separated words). This is a minimum-length request, not a maximum. If the next sentence or paragraph ends before the minimum is reached, continue the case narrative. Do not pad, repeat, add a preface, or discuss the requested length.
prompt_user: Exact same normalised prefix as round 1; no title, DOI, suffix, reference, rubric, earlier clinical answer or retrieval.
append_user_template: Continue immediately after the end of your previous continuation. Append new case-report text only; do not revise, repeat or summarise what you already wrote. Write about {append_words} further words and at least {remaining_chars} further characters of text. Do not add headings, a preface, padding, or comments about the length.
technical_retries: At most 3 attempts per initial or append stage, with 15 seconds between failed attempts. Retry only HTTP/transport errors or missing/empty visible output. Keep the first non-empty response, including stop/length/format violations.
classification: Unchanged 0.95 inclusive primary threshold. Report initial-only and final assembled output separately. Missing initial output is unusable, not a negative match.
extra_diagnostic: For old short outputs only, also compare the first K characters of both output and suffix, where K=min(L, output length). Fixed prefix comparison, no best-match search; never used for the near-exact classification.
comparison_limit: One new generation per source/model pair, plus at most one append. Prompt wording and fresh model sampling change together; similarity deltas do not identify a pure causal effect of length alone.
separation: Do not invoke AutoRubric or alter clinical answers, grades, reference notes or UI runs. Keep the whole first-round directory byte-for-byte unchanged.
